name: ogxo-route
description: Cost-aware routing for Claude Code: a routing skill and session-start summary that tell the main session which tier handles which task, worker subagents pinned to Sonnet or Haiku with explicit tool lists, hooks that warn when a generic subagent is dispatched without a model and log each dispatch and permission request, and opt-in alerts when Claude Code waits on a permission prompt. Risky work and reviews stay at Opus or above. Warns, never blocks. Claude Code only. Requires jq.
